conbody.p: The lumbar support can be adjusted by pressing the lumbar support switch on the side of the seat.

li.p: Press the front portion of the switch to increase support, or the rear portion of the switch, to decrease support.
Press the upper portion of the switch to raise the support, or the lower portion of the switch, to lower the support.
Release the switch once it reaches the desired position.
Do not continue to operate the lumbar support when the lumbar support provides its maximum support. Damage to the lumbar support motor could occur.
Make sure to turn off the lumbar massage switch while your vehicle is turned off.
Otherwise, the 12V battery will still be consumed for up to 15 minutes, potentially causing your vehicle to fail to restart.
